text.title: NIGHTSHIFT
text.subtitle: Every night from 2:00 to 3:00, the town has a second shift.
text.title_keys: Z choose   X back   arrows move   F11 fullscreen
text.new_confirm: Start over? Every night so far is forgotten.
text.hint_help: Do one step of their job. +{cost_help} min. Slow, but makes a friend.
text.hint_hustle: Press {confirm} when the line is in the orange. Fast, but makes an enemy.
text.hint_stall: Wait it out. Hits this round do half.
text.hint_wick_locked: You are on your own. For now.
text.hint_wick_light: Wick lights the arena. You can see everything this round. Free.
text.hint_wick_hold: Wick blocks the first hit this round. +{cost_wick_hold} min.
text.rewind_prompt: Press {rewind} to wind the watch back!
text.reason_asleep: You fell asleep on the job.
text.board_keys: left / right to read   X to step back
